scripts.dev:browser: npm run local:prepare && npm run dev
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @ebonkeep/shared run test:unit && npm --workspace @ebonkeep/api run test:unit && npm --workspace @ebonkeep/web run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:db:prepare && npm --workspace @ebonkeep/api run test:integration
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:db:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:db:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:nightly: npm run test:db:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/nightly
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:smoke
